content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Thanks [user_name]. Today I connected the [product_name] to my laptop using a USB cable and it worked well without any issues. However, yesterday I attempted to download a program to several memory EPROMs simultaneously using a PROM kit [article_no]. This kit operates with a serial cable, but it does not function when connected via USB cable. Does anyone have insights about this issue?

Greetings, I don't have experience with the [product_name] PROM—perhaps it needs a firmware update. You might consider contacting [company_name] Hotline or submitting a support request as previously suggested. Be sure to provide all relevant information including details about the PROM, your PC, software version, and the [product_name] you intend to use. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users found that although the [product_name] connects easily to a laptop via USB cable, the PROM kit does not work with USB and requires a serial connection. This creates confusion and disrupts workflow for those wishing to use newer hardware interfaces.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate that the PROM kit should be compatible with USB connections, just like the [product_name], for improved convenience and efficiency when using modern hardware.
